note: Shared connection-type library (keeper: agent 2). Few fastener sizes on purpose: M2, M3, M4. Subsystems may add types in their own interfaces.json; propose common ones via redesign/interfaces/CHANGE-REQUESTS.md. Connector ratings: see redesign/inputs/DECISIONS-ADOPTED.md.

connection_types.spec: M2 self-tapping or machine screw into printed/plastic boss (servo ears)
M3 SHCS into M3 brass heat-set insert
M3 SHCS through clearance hole, nyloc nut
M3 SHCS into motor base tapped hole (manufacturer pattern)
M4 SHCS through clearance hole, nyloc nut
epoxy bond (30 min laminating epoxy), surfaces scuffed
printed split clamp around round tube, closed by fasteners listed in the joint stack
pin hinge, printed knuckles + steel pin
MR30 3-pin (motor phases at a removable joint)
thermal pad between heat source and sink
